{'text': '404 Media recently reported a vulnerability in iCloud+\'s "Hide My Email" feature that could allow anyone to obtain a user\'s real email address. Apple has now confirmed that the issue has been officially fixed.', 'target': '最近 404 Media 報導指 iCloud+ 的「隱藏我的電郵」功能存在漏洞，可讓任何人取得用戶的真實電郵地址。Apple 現表示問題已正式修復。'}

{'text': 'Apple says the security flaw in "Hide My Email" was patched earlier this month.', 'target': 'Apple 表示，「隱藏我的電郵」的安全漏洞已於本月初完成修補'}

{'text': 'If you are an iCloud+ or Apple One subscriber, Apple\'s "Hide My Email" privacy feature is particularly useful for protecting your real email address.', 'target': '如果你是 iCloud+ 或 Apple One 訂閱用戶，Apple 提供「隱藏我的電郵」私隱功能，對於保護你的真實電郵地址尤其實用。'}

{'text': "Here's how it works, according to Apple's official website:", 'target': '以下是根據 Apple 官方網站的運作說明：'}

{'text': 'However, according to a recent 404 Media report, "Hide My Email" has long contained a flaw that could allow anyone to obtain the real email address linked to an Apple account. This disclosure has prompted a new proposed lawsuit.', 'target': '不過根據 404 Media 最近的報導，「隱藏我的電郵」長期存在一個漏洞，可讓任何人取得綁定 Apple 帳戶的真實電郵地址。這項披露引發了一宗新的擬議訴訟。'}

{'text': 'However, Apple today said the flaw was officially fixed earlier this month.', 'target': '不過 Apple 今日表示，該漏洞已於本月初正式修復。'}

{'text': 'Apple told 404 Media that it deployed a patch for the issue on July 3, and said the problem has been fully resolved.', 'target': 'Apple 告訴 404 Media，公司已於 7 月 3 日就相關問題部署修補程式，並稱問題已獲全面解決。'}

{'text': 'The iCloud+ vulnerability was originally reported to Apple by Tyler Murphy in June 2025. In their initial communication, Apple claimed it had been fixed, but Murphy found the issue still persisted. Hopefully this time it has truly been resolved.', 'target': '該 iCloud+ 漏洞最初於 2025 年 6 月由 Tyler Murphy 向 Apple 報告。在最初的溝通中，Apple 聲稱已修復，但 Murphy 發現問題仍然存在。希望今次真的能徹底解決問題。'}

{'text': 'How often do you use iCloud+\'s "Hide My Email" feature? Let us know in the comments.', 'target': '你有多常使用 iCloud+ 的「隱藏我的電郵」功能？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。'}
